name: roofline_use_maf_not_peak
description: Use Max-Achievable FLOPs (~50% of vendor peak) as the roofline denominator, not peak TFLOPS; citing peak makes every kernel look bad and hides actual tuning headroom
preconditions: Computing roofline efficiency for a GEMM or attention kernel
Target hardware is MI300X / MI325X / MI355X
steps: Look up MAF for the target GPU and dtype from the hardware table: MI300X/MI325X bf16=650 fp8=1300 TFLOPs; MI355X bf16=1260 fp8=2500 TFLOPs
efficiency = roofline_time / measured_time x 100%; aim for >=80%, escalate <60%
expected_impact: reports efficiency numbers that correspond to realistic tuning targets; avoids reporting 40% when the kernel is actually 80% of the achievable bound
decision_rules: If a colleague quotes efficiency using peak TFLOPS, recompute with MAF before acting on the number
